proves.claim: A register whose first argument carries a role is floored at ADVISOR_ROLE_ENGINE; one with no role keeps its old floor.

moves.logic-moves-register.clause-1-a-ro.why: A recorded advisor role must never replay under an engine older than its own leaf.

proves.claim: The BAD_ROLE refusal text tells the caller to use --role advisor or leave --role off.

moves.logic-moves-register.clause-2-bad-.why: A refused role must name the fix, not just the code.
